mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of window replacement in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window replacement in Orange County can vary significantly based on several factors, including the type of windows, frame material, glass options (e.g., double-pane, low-E), and installation complexity. Generally, prices range from a few hundred dollars per window for basic vinyl to over a thousand for premium materials like wood or fiberglass, especially for custom sizes or historic homes. We offer free, no-obligation consultations to provide an accurate estimate tailored to your specific needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window replacement costs in Orange County vary based on window type, material, and installation complexity. Expect prices to range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window. We provide custom estimates.
